text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet discusses Saddam's letter on financial incentives.
- Saddam says he wants Iraq to be master of itself.
- Saddam receives congratulations on his birthday from King Hussein of Jordan.
- Iraq informs U.N. Security Council of U.S. attempts to block implementation of oil-for-food deal.
- Iraq urges countries in region to work for lifting of sanctions.
- Government offers new prices for wheat and barley shipped to its silos.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ)
- Article on importance of dates in securing Iraq's self-reliance in food.
- Iraqi Kurds reject rebel leader Jalal Talabani for attempts to coordinate with Iraq's enemies.
- Saddam's statue decorates entrance to border post of Treibeel with Jordan.
